reuse.why: Implements the option inside the tree's existing shared policy shouldBudgetCategory (month-budget-categories.ts) that all six month-wide actions already call.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the only repetition is passing includeHiddenCategories through each of the six action signatures and calls, which the existing per-action structure requires.

placement.why: The hidden-category decision stays in the shared category policy module; actions only forward the flag, and their queries already leave hidden filtering to that policy.

scope.why: Functionally focused, but carries formatting-only churn (reflowed type literals, test calls and an added blank import line) unrelated to the feature.

maintainability.why: One defaulted parameter on one policy function keeps the hidden rule in a single place; a trailing positional boolean is slightly less readable than an options object.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All six actions go through shouldBudgetCategory.
